help:
usage: gnd validate [-h] [--trace] [--format {text,json}] model

Validate the model; version-4 references bind beneath its parent with disjoint
fixed ownership and exact raw hashes.

positional arguments:
  model                 path to the model file

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --trace               report what a transition run would evaluate, WITHOUT
                        evaluating anything: the two digests every steps.json
                        must carry, which preconditions compile to standing
                        obligations and which are retained per-step and why,
                        and the frame modality each fact type would be graded
                        with. Reports; never decides, never reads a
                        population. This is the only shipped producer of
                        operations_digest, which every steps.json is required
                        to carry
  --format {text,json}  output rendering: human-readable text (default) or one
                        JSON payload
